selection.cohort: Publisher-labeled normal and botnet flows in the source topology; unknown/background flows excluded before aggregation. This is a label-conditioned cohort, not all captured traffic.
selection.candidate_policy: 15-minute source-host windows; half heuristic volume/fanout/failed-connection priority, half stable hash sample; no labels used for selecting windows within the known cohort.

source.truth_kind: publisher From-Botnet labels; host/behavior groups, not independent incidents
source.cohort: publisher-known normal and botnet flows only
source.time_note: naive publisher timestamps treated as nominal UTC for within-capture ordering only

budget_unit: unique observed pairs within each run, including equal-grade and unknown pairs
error_definition: final relative order contradicts unequal known publisher grades
limitations: Exploratory, retrospective analysis of three historical controlled malware captures from 2011, not live production traffic or a fresh holdout.

Labels define a restricted normal/botnet cohort before ranking; all unknown/background flows are excluded. Candidate selection then loses 67 of 163 known-positive windows and four host/behavior groups.
Review queues use only model preferences and stable identities. Equal-grade and unknown pairs consume budget; only known final-order errors are scored.
Unique pairs within a run are the network review unit. Synthetic replay uses individual pair observations and preference errors; do not pool these outcomes.
Repeated seeds and pairs sharing hosts, windows and contexts are correlated. Pair preferences are not calibrated error confidence.
An ordering error is not an independently useful finding, recovered incident or verified causal relationship. No analyst study or time-savings claim.
Raw source files remain external. Their hashes and representative byte references are retained, but this offline verification checks the bundled normalized evidence and recorded model responses.
All original selected receipt/wire fields are preserved; case_id, run_id, receipt_index and source_http_line add scoped references. Labels never enter request state.
